qa.answer: The notice period is 60 days from the day you tender your resignation. A shorter release is possible only if the named approver agrees a notice buyout.
Final wages are due within two working days of your last working day. In Counterfoil this deadline is a clock that closes only when the payroll system's own record shows the payment.
qa.cite: Code on Wages, 2019, s.17(2) — flagged needs_legal_confirmation

qa.answer: Gratuity needs roughly five years of continuous service (the demo rule pack uses 4.75 years as the eligibility line, flagged for legal confirmation) and is payable within thirty days.
qa.cite: Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972, s.4 and s.7(3)

qa.answer: Your relieving letter is issued within 7 days of your last working day; in this platform it is generated and receipted at step 17.
Unused earned leave is encashed in your final settlement at gross/30 per day; your balance is read from the HR record and each line of the settlement carries its citation.
An asset-return ticket is raised with IT on acceptance, due by your last working day. Clearance is re-checked against IT's own system on the last day, not assumed.
